title: BezelSettingDefinition
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py::BezelSettingDefinition. The bezel wall is derived by offsetting the stone's OWN girdle outline, so the pipeline is outline-agnostic and a future custom outline flows through unchanged (brief section 19). See docs/bible/21-setting/bezel-setting-contract.md.

wallThicknessMm.description: Constant geometric offset applied outward from the stone girdle outline. When defaulted (0.6) this is a PRELIMINARY SOFTWARE VALUE in the same class as band.width — a deliberate, configurable software choice, NEVER a professional recommendation (SETTING-GOV-010). No minimum is enforced because no sourced professional minimum exists.

wallHeightMm.description: Total vertical extent of the wall. When defaulted (2.5) this is likewise a PRELIMINARY SOFTWARE VALUE.

verticalReference.description: The wall is centred on the stone's girdle plane: bottom at girdlePlaneZ - wallHeight/2, top at girdlePlaneZ + wallHeight/2. An explicit, symmetric rule chosen precisely to avoid fabricating an asymmetric crown/pavilion coverage split.

outlineOffsetMode.description: A true constant-distance offset (cq.Wire.offset2D), not a scaled outline — so wall thickness is uniform around the whole perimeter.
